limitations: Shortcuts/crouch and independent camera remain guarded to supported first-map states; other overlays and broader traversal are unverified.
Q requires Boot already selected, standing still and no upper-body action; independent armed kick unsupported.
R has no stored steroid dose; original steroids activate on pickup.
Gadget shortcuts reject unsupported airborne/swimming/traversal states; airborne jetpack toggling unverified/disabled by the lease.
Original lit dynamite and gadget transitions retain their completion requirements.
Static low ceilings, dynamic geometry/object-relative supports, tight-room/wall compression and camera comfort need representative playtests.
Distance preference lasts within the process; shoulder/recenter and broader D10 remain open.
